capability.summary: Check a Python path with Black and return the proposed formatting diff without modifying files
capability.description: Runs `black --check --diff <target>` against one existing path. It reports whether Black formatting is already satisfied and emits Black's textual diff, but check mode never applies the formatting.
capability.problem_space: Read-only Black formatting compliance and diff generation for Python paths; not source rewriting, lint-rule analysis, or security scanning.

constraint.io_signature: Input: one required existing Black-compatible file or directory path; output: a JSON wrapper with Black's check exit code and untruncated textual diff/stdout and stderr.
accepted_inputs: an existing Python source file path accepted by Black
an existing directory path accepted by Black for recursive format checking
constraint.output_shape: Completed check (Black exit 0 or 1): {status: "success", tool: "black", target: string, exit_code: 0|1, result: null, stdout: string, stderr: string|null}; exit 0 means already formatted and exit 1 means Black would reformat, with any diff in stdout. Other Black exits use the same keys with status="tool_error" and propagate the actual exit code. Missing path/executable/timeout: {status: "error", tool: "black", message: string}, exiting 2/3/4. Missing argument prints usage to stderr and exits 1 without JSON.
limitations: despite the runner name, fixed `--check --diff` flags make this check-only and it never writes formatted code
does not expose Black configuration or flags through manifest inputs; Black may still discover project configuration on its own
requires `black` on PATH, uses a fixed 120-second timeout, and does not truncate captured stdout or stderr

output_contract.description: JSON execution envelope with Black's check exit code, full proposed diff/stdout, stderr, and target; no file is formatted.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

intent_tags: check whether Python code matches Black formatting
preview Black formatting changes as a diff
negative_intents: apply Black formatting or rewrite Python files
lint Python with flake8 or Ruff
scan Python code for Bandit security findings
